name: Seerstone
author: Blair Williams
description: A fast media browser for Omarchy: open a folder and flip through its images, PDFs, audio and video from a compact sidebar. Zoom, rotate and save, export to other formats, play and scrub with frame-exact seeking, step video frame by frame, and pin notes to a moment, frame, page or picture. Notes live beside each file as a plain Markdown checklist, ready to hand to an AI. Adds a bar button that opens Seerstone.

barWidget.description: Opens Seerstone, the media browser. Until Seerstone is installed, it runs the installer in a terminal.
